changes: Contrastive update to base encoder weights; original tokenizer unchanged.
Attention-mask-aware mean pooling and L2 normalization; unused publisher pooler outside this embedding function.
Explicit mixed quantization: FP32 embeddings and six FFN output projections, other30of36constantlinear weights INT8; U8/S8 export identities distinct.
